name: Kanban task manager
description: A Kanban-style task management app built with **React**, **Redux**, and **Tailwind CSS** on the frontend, and **NestJS** with **TypeORM** on the backend. It supports full CRUD operations on boards, columns, tasks, and subtasks, with drag-and-drop functionality for moving tasks between columns. The interface is fully responsive, working seamlessly on both desktop and mobile.

name: Budgeting app
description: A budgeting app built with **Symfony (PHP)** and **React (TypeScript, ShadCN)** featuring a user-friendly dashboard, secure login/registration, and full task control: add, edit, delete, or set repeating tasks to manage expenses efficiently.

name: React ecommerce
description: A simple eCommerce shop built with **React, TypeScript**, and **Redux**. Users can browse products, add them to the cart, and place orders. **Clean design** and smooth experience make it easy to manage and extend for small to mid-sized online stores.
